nombre: Choza Básica Orco de las Llanuras
canon: Construcción típica de los clanes orcos de las Llanuras (tier 2): un armazón de huesos largos de gargantúa clavados en tierra y atados entre sí con cuerda de tendón, formando una estructura curva más alta que un orco de pie (el mismo respeto por el hueso de gargantúa que en el Osario de la Manada). Sobre ese esqueleto se tensan pieles cosidas como paredes y techo, con una sola abertura baja de entrada, a veces con la marca del clan grabada en el poste. Una sola estancia, más permanente y resistente al viento que un campamento.

prompt.sujeto: A single domed hut standing alone on a red desert plain, seen from a low camera angle three-quarters from the front, filling the left half of the image.
prompt.proporcion: The dome is about twice as wide as it is tall, and its low entrance reaches only a third of its height.
prompt.cuerpo: Its frame is a ring of huge, curved pale bones driven into the ground and bent together over the top, lashed at every crossing with thick cords of dark tendon. Sewn hides in patched shades of red-brown and tan are stretched tight between the bones as walls and roof, their seams stitched with coarse cord.
rasgos: A single low, dark doorway opens at the front, framed by a thick upright bone post carved with a bold black clan mark.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: The hides are weathered and faded where the wind strikes them, and red dust has piled in a low drift along the windward side.
prompt.pose: A dry wind tugs at the loose edge of a hide near the base and blows a thin streamer of red dust past the doorway.
prompt.entorno: The ground is cracked red earth with sparse dry tufts; to the left, tall red rock spires rise in the middle distance, and flat-topped mesas fade into haze on the far horizon under a wide sky of broken golden cloud.
prompt.luz: Warm, hazy daylight falls from high on the right, picking out the curve of the bones and the stitched seams, and laying a soft shadow to the left of the hut.

momento:atardecer.luz: The low sun sits behind thin cloud on the right and rims the bones and hides with warm orange light, while long shadows stretch across the red earth.

momento:noche.luz: Warm firelight spills from the low doorway onto the ground in front of the hut, while the bones and hides above fade into deep cool shadow.

propuestas: diseño de la imagen del juego (usuaria, 2026-10-26: «todo lo que hay ahora en las imágenes es lo que me gustaría igualar»); donde choca con el canon, va como propuesta de lore
del banner y fuera del canon: forma de cúpula baja, pieles remendadas en rojo pardo y tostado, marca negra del clan en el poste, agujas de roca roja a la izquierda y cielo de nubes doradas
se quitan del banner el cráneo y los huesos pequeños al pie de la choza (el canon pide respeto por el hueso de gargantúa y no los describe)
la marca del clan, que el canon pone «a veces», va siempre en el prompt
fuego dentro por la noche: diseño de imagen, no canon

capas.sujeto: A single domed hut standing alone on a desert plain, seen from a low camera angle three-quarters from the front, filling the left half of the image.
capas.tamano: The dome is a little taller than a tall man standing and about twice as wide as it is tall, and its low entrance reaches only a third of its height.
capas.forma: Its frame is a ring of huge, long curved bones driven into the ground and bent together over the top, lashed at every crossing with thick cords of sinew. Sewn hides are stretched tight between the bones as walls and roof, their seams stitched with coarse cord, and weathered where the wind strikes them. A single low doorway opens at the front, framed by a thick upright bone post carved with a bold clan mark.
capas.pose: A dry wind tugs at the loose edge of a hide near the base and blows a thin streamer of dust past the doorway.
capas.entorno: The ground is cracked earth with sparse dry tufts and a low drift of fine sand along the windward side of the hut; to the left, tall jagged rock pinnacles rise in the middle distance, and flat-topped mesas fade into haze on the far horizon under a wide sky of broken clouds.
capas.color: The bones are pale, weathered and cracked; the cords dark brown; the hides patched in shades of red-brown and tan, faded where the wind strikes them; the clan mark is black and the doorway a hollow of deep shadow. The ground, the pinnacles and the far mesas are red, the sand drift red, the sky broken golden cloud.
capas.paleta: rust red, bone white and golden ochre
capas.corto: A single domed hut alone on a desert plain, low angle, three-quarters from the front, filling the left half of the image. Warm hazy daylight from high on the right lays a soft shadow to the left. A ring of huge curved bones is driven into the ground, bent together over the top and lashed with sinew cord. Sewn hides stretched between the bones form walls and roof. The dome is a little taller than a man and twice as wide as tall, with one low doorway in deep shadow. Bones pale, hides tan. Cracked red earth, rock pinnacles and mesas behind.
capas.luz: Warm, hazy daylight falls from high on the right, picking out the curve of the bones and the stitched seams, and laying a soft shadow to the left of the hut.

capasIA.corto: A massive frame of giant long bones stands upright on the ground, bound together by thick tendon rope. The curved structure rises higher than a standing human, with skin stretched and stitched over the bones to form walls and a roof. A single low opening serves as the entrance. The scene is set on a vast dusty steppe with tufts of dry straw-yellow grass tinged with orange. Fine dusty particles drift on the wind, and low volcanic peaks appear far off in the haze.
capasIA.sujeto: A large hut stands alone in the landscape.
capasIA.luz: Low sun just above the horizon throws a warm golden rim light on the bone frame and the stretched skins, while the interior and the ground beneath remain in deep shadow.
capasIA.tamano: The hut is taller than a standing human and wider than the nearby tufts of grass.
capasIA.forma: The frame is a curved arch made of long bones, with thick tendon rope binding the joints. The walls are skin stretched tight over the bone ribs, and the roof slopes down from the highest bone to the ground.
capasIA.entorno: The ground is red clay dotted with dry straw-yellow grass. In the middle distance, scattered savanna scrub grows between tufts of grass. The horizon shows low volcanic peaks fading into the haze.
capasIA.color: red clay, straw-yellow grass with orange tinge, bone, stretched skin, tendon rope, dusty
capasIA.paleta: red clay, straw-yellow grass and orange dust with one accent of warm golden light
